card.name: Start of hemostasis words
card.fires_on: The piece "hem" that begins words like hemostasis or hemostatic, in surgical or implant instructions. Weaker hits on a few other word-starts or linking words.

modes.label: hem- in hemostasis
modes.description: The word-start "hem" before "ostasis" or "ostatic" in procedure steps about stopping bleeding.
modes.example: Use only minimum amount of TachoSil patches necessary to achieve<< hem>>ostasis.

modes.label: Other scattered hits
modes.description: Occasional linking words or partial words in clinical text, such as "or" in a list of conditions.
modes.example: History of stroke<< or>> transient ischemic attack (TIA)
